scope: Windows creator workspace, signed-in Antigravity CLI, and an isolated project. One read-only ACP turn and scoped launcher/preview checks.

native_desktop.input: Windows UI Automation and an owned WM_CLOSE message

transport_fixture.kind: synthetic ACP peer alongside the existing RPC contract tests

recovered_failures.cause: The prompt response could be handled before the final text notification reached the UI, inserting the turn separator inside the world ID.
recovered_failures.resolution: Wait for delivered text and tool notifications before marking the prompt complete.

recovered_failures.cause: The Windows test tried to observe an internal status label through an unavailable UI Automation peer.
recovered_failures.resolution: Use the Send control's ready state and verify the complete response exactly.

limits: The actual Antigravity turn read world.inspect with user-scoped UI approval and preserved world and manifest hashes.
Antigravity authoring, resume, cancellation completion and standalone client setup were not exercised.
The Codex checks cover connect and reconnect without a model turn.
